name: house-bills
description: Nodes represent legislators. Each hyperedge represents a bill and contains the set of legislators associated with that bill (e.g., sponsor and cosponsor lists).

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., house-bills).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., true).

nodes_metadata.label: (STRING) Political party affiliation (e.g., Democrat).
nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Legislator name with state and district (e.g., MOSS).

edges_metadata.weight: (INT) Number of bills collapsed into this legislator-set hyperedge (e.g., 7).
